metadata.label: Description
metadata.value: Ellor-gāst, or alien spirit, explores the theme of the monster in Beowulf. The book consists of eight aquatints and eight translations by Shirley Jones, an introduction and linked passages. With the title page and postscript, there are ten illustrations, the colours being mainly limited to the dark green and red of the text, printed in 18- and 12-pt Baskerville type, on paper handmade by Jacques Brejoux, at Moulin du Verger, France. Thirty copies are quarter bound in green morocco with printed canvas boards by Jen Lindsay. Copy 38/40, signed by Shirley Jones, dated 1986.
